wait.reason: mbed wait(): busy delay that halts all processing (maintainer: 'wait() is not allowed anywhere in smoothie')

wait_ms.reason: busy delay that halts all processing

wait_us.reason: busy delay that halts all processing (maintainer: 'you cannot use wait_us, it blocks')

safe_delay_ms.reason: keeps running the idle handlers but still blocks the caller; the maintainer's opinion on it is not on record

wait_for_idle.reason: waits for the planner queue to drain; accepted by the maintainers (pending final confirmation), never reported

short_wait.reason: a wait of about 1-2 microseconds is shorter than a function call overhead on the MCU; the maintainer still objected to wait_us(1) in PR 1219 ('blocks the entire system for 1 us'), so the maintainers decide

accepted_runtime_waits.reason: display-driver bit-bang setup/hold times (ST7920 10 us per byte, ST7565 20-40 us); datasheet timing in merged edge code, tens of microseconds, not a design choice

known_debt_runtime_waits.reason: one-time LCD power-on delays (90 ms and 10 ms in RrdGlcd::initDisplay) run from Panel::on_idle on edge today; reported as a warning, not a failure, until the panel init becomes a state machine

long_handler_allow.Endstops::ON_GCODE_RECEIVED: G28 homing: the handler runs the homing moves and loops on idle events until they finish; long by design
long_handler_allow.ZProbe::ON_GCODE_RECEIVED: G30/G32 probing: the handler runs probe moves and waits for them to finish; long by design
long_handler_allow.Panel::ON_IDLE: LCD power-on delays (see known_debt_runtime_waits); counted as a wait there
long_handler_allow.Robot::ON_GCODE_RECEIVED: G4 dwell: drains the queue (wait_for_idle, allowed), then loops running idle events for the requested P milliseconds (Robot.cpp, case 4)
long_handler_allow.Player::ON_MAIN_LOOP: M600 suspend (the filament detector's jam response): suspend_part2 drains the planner queue with wait_for_idle (allowed), then runs the park move (Player.cpp, suspend_part2)
long_handler_allow.Switch::ON_GCODE_RECEIVED: drains the planner queue with wait_for_idle (allowed) before it changes the output (Switch.cpp, on_gcode_received)
long_handler_allow.TemperatureControl::ON_GCODE_RECEIVED: M104/M109 drain the planner queue with wait_for_idle (allowed) before setting the temperature (TemperatureControl.cpp:342)
